purpose: Losslessly export the three sealed V9 composite checkpoints and their runtime contract into the pinned ROS Python 3.8/Torch 2.0 runtime.

approval.scope: One immutable three-checkpoint V9 deployment export; no world data, training, graph or robot execution.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing authorization for in-scope choices and formal runs without repeated approval.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local deployment conversion of project-trained research checkpoints only.

strict_test: C09, C10 and all M-TARE observations are forbidden

sampling.rule: Read each sealed V9 checkpoint once; copy tensors and the exact primitive runtime contract without arithmetic mutation; read no sample or world asset.

teacher.source: No teacher or labels are read.
teacher.valid_mask: All parameter names/shapes/dtypes/values and V9 runtime-contract fields must survive source export and both runtime loads.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No planner executes. A fixed synthetic input must preserve all forward outputs across Torch 2.9 and ROS Torch 2.0 within 1e-6.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only three V9 checkpoint files and their sealed source evidence are read.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only; three exports and six fixed-probe forwards; zero research-sample inference.

evidence.machine_metrics: Three deployment checkpoints, 126 tensor hashes, preserved V9 runtime contracts, six probe archives, cross-runtime comparisons, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: No image is useful for this serialization boundary.
evidence.failure_policy: Any input/tool/image/contract/tensor/output drift is immediate sealed FAIL with no retry or tensor repair.
